result.title: SEAF: Selective Semantic Enrichment and Visual Evidence Fusion for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
result.summary: Multimodal sarcasm detection requires textual, visual, and contextual evidence, particularly when multiple images provide complementary cues. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate auxiliary information from a post's text and images, but their outputs may mix useful background knowledge with redundant visual descriptions. We propose SEAF, a dual-branch framework for selective semantic enrichment and visual evidence fusion. SEAF assigns generated fields to distinct roles: entity background enriches semantic input, while image descriptions supply alignment statistics. The semantic branch combines the original post text, background from a frozen MLLM, and optical character recognition (OCR) text. The aligned visual branch combines global and local visual features with statistics of cross-modal and inter-image similarity. Text-Anchored Smoothed Aggregation (TASA) weights images by their similarity to the original post text while preserving contributions from images with low literal similarity. Summing the branch classification scores integrates contextual semantics with visual evidence. Experiments on the multi-image MMSD3.0 benchmark show that SEAF outperforms all compared methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SEAF 双分支框架做多图多模态讽刺检测：把冻结 MLLM 生成的实体背景用于语义分支（与原文、OCR 文本融合），图像描述只提供跨模态与图间对齐统计，视觉分支融合全局与局部特征，并以 TASA 按图文相似度加权图像后相加两分支得分。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按图文相似度加权、并刻意保留低字面相似图像贡献的视觉证据筛选方式，可能可供核查 LVR 中多视觉证据的筛选与支持组合；但该工作落点是分类任务而非 latent 推理状态生成，迁移需自行判断。
